title: 高電圧パルスパワー工学
subtitle: High-Voltage Pulsed Power Engineering
keywords: Electric field strength 2.Pre-breakdown phenomena 3.Dielectric breakdown phenomena 4.Generation of HV 5.Application of HV
educationalGoal: Students will (1) learn dielectric and electrical insulation phenomena in gas, liquid, and solid. (2) learn how to generate AC, DC, and Impulse voltage. (3) learn how to measure high voltage and high current. (4) learn various high voltage testing.
advice: Course description 1. Electrostatic fields and electrical field calculation 2. Elementary physics of electrical discharge 3. Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in gas 4. Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in liquid and solid dielectrics 5. Generation of various high voltages, measurement of high voltages and high currents, high voltage insulation test techniques 6. Application of high-voltage and pulsed power engineering Expectations To understand the lecture well, knowledge about “electromagnetics (electrostatic fields)”, “electrical machinery (transformer)”, and “transient phenomena in liner circuits” are required.
books: Textbook: Fundamentals of high voltage engineering, ISBN: 9784817302380 (in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: This course is strongly related to the following courses: “Electromagnetics (Electrostatics)”, “Transient Phenomena in Linear Circuits”, and “Electrical Machinery (Transformer)”. Therefore, reviewing the basic knowledge obtained from those related courses is necessary in advance.

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate the electrical field strength by analytical formula derived from Gauss's law
Be able to understand the kinetics of charged particles and to explain elementary physics of electrical discharg
Be able to understand the Townsend breakdown theory, Paschen's law, and streamer theory in gas.
Be able to understand the electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in liquid and solid dielectrics.
Be able to understand the AC, DC and impulse voltage generator, and insulation test techniques.
Be able to explain the application of high-voltage and pulsed power engineering.

lessons.content: [Guidance] *Explanation of syllabus [Introduction of high-voltage pulsed power engineering] [Electrostatic fields and electrical field calculation 1] *Uniform and non-uniform electrostatic fields
lessons.assignments: *To understand electrostatic fields and electrical field calculation

lessons.content: [Electrostatic fields and electrical field calculation 2 ] *Uniform and non-uniform electrostatic fields in multi-dielectric isotropic materials
lessons.assignments: *To understand electrostatic fields and electrical field calculation

lessons.content: [Elementary physics of electrical discharge 1] *Number density *Thermal motion of particles *Drift velocity *Similarity law
lessons.assignments: *To understand elementary physics of electrical discharge

lessons.content: [Elementary physics of electrical discharge 2] *Generation and extinction of charged particles *Electron emission from metal electrodes
lessons.assignments: *To understand elementary physics of electrical discharge

lessons.content: [Self-reflection class] [Quiz 1] *Evaluation targets are the class number 1 to 3 *Self-check of understanding level [Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in gas 1] *Townsend breakdown theory *Townsend coefficient (α)
lessons.operation: Questionnaire and quiz Lecture and Q&A
lessons.assignments: *To review the contents of the lecture 1 to 3 *To understand Townsend breakdown theory

lessons.content: [Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in gas 2] *Secondary electron emission coefficient (γ) *Townsend's criterion *Paschen’s law *Meek criterion of streamer formation
lessons.assignments: *To understand Paschen's law and Meek criterion of streamer formation

lessons.content: [Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in gas 3] *Features of self-sustaining discharges (corona discharge, glow discharge, arc discharge ). *Standard lightning and switching impulse voltages *V-t curve *Lightning stroke *electrical discharges in high vacuum *High frequency discharge
lessons.assignments: *To understand impulse voltages, V-t curve, lightning stroke, various types of electrical discharges

lessons.content: [Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in gas 4] *Creeping discharge *Dielectric barrier discharge *Observation techniques for optical emission from electrical discharges
lessons.assignments: *To understand various types of electrical discharges in composite insulation and observation techniques for electrical discharges

lessons.content: [Self-reflection class] [Examination 1] *Evaluation of the achievement level of program objectives 1 to 3 [Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in liquid and solid dielectrics 1] *Electric conduction and electrical breakdown phenomena in liquid dielectrics
lessons.operation: Questionnaire and Examination Lecture and Q&A
lessons.assignments: *To review contents of the lecture 1 to 7 *To understand electrical conduction phenomena in uniform and non-uniform electrostatics fields

lessons.content: [Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in liquid and solid dielectrics 2] *Theories of electrical breakdown phenomena in liquid dielectrics
lessons.assignments: *To understand electronic breakdown theory and bubble breakdown theory.

lessons.content: [Electrical breakdown and conduction phenomena in liquid and solid dielectrics 3] *Electrical conduction and dielectric breakdown phenomena in solid dielectrics *Theories of electrical breakdown phenomena in solid dielectrics
lessons.assignments: *To understand (1) dielectric polarization and dielectric loss, (2) electrical conduction phenomena in solid dielectrics, (3) mechanisms of intrinsic, avalanche and thermal breakdown in solid dielectrics, and (4) partial discharges and treeing phenomena

lessons.content: [Self-reflection class] [Quiz 2] *Evaluation targets are class number 8 to 10 *Self-check of understanding level [Generation of high voltages 1] *AC high voltage
lessons.operation: Questionnaire and quiz Lecture and Q&A
lessons.assignments: * To review the contents of the lecture 8 to 10. *To understand how to generate AC high voltage by transformer or series resonant circuit

lessons.content: [Generation of high voltages 2] *DC high voltage *Impulse voltage [Measurement of high voltages and high currents] *Voltage probe, divider, shunt, CT [High voltage insulation test techniques] *Non-destructive test *Withstand voltage test *Breakdown voltage test
lessons.assignments: *To understand how to generate DC high voltage by Cockcroft-Walton circuit and impulse voltage by Marx generator. *To understand how to measure high voltage and high current *To understand various types of insulation test

lessons.content: [Self-reflection class] *Self-check of understanding level *Questionnaire of the lecture [Examination 2] *Evaluation of the achievement level of program objectives 4 and 5
lessons.operation: Questionnaire and Examination Lecture and Q&A
lessons.assignments: *To review the contents of the lecture 8 to 13

lessons.content: [Application of high voltage and pulsed power engineering] *Electrostatic precipitator (ESP) *Ozone generator [Self-check lecture] *Explanation of results evaluation method *Notice of evaluation results *Questionnaire of the lecture
